title: Amazon's New $75 AI Gadget Remembers What You Say
description:
On October 15, Amazon's Bee launched two AI recorders: the $74.99 Bee Frontier wearable (on sale now) and the $99.99 Bee Eclipse phone attachment (coming soon).
Both turn your conversations into summaries, to-dos and reminders. Amazon says audio is deleted after processing; the free plan keeps 14 days of memory and Bee Pro costs $11.99/month.
